description: Sites d'injection de biométhane en Haute-Garonne (source ODRÉ - Open Data Réseaux-Énergies) is a dataset listed in Open Data Haute-Garonne, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by GRDF, NaTran, Terega, SPEGNN. Ce jeu de données (résultats filtrés sur le département de la Haute-Garonne) présente la liste des points d'injection de biométhane dans les réseaux de gaz naturel en France et la capacité de production de biométhane en GWh/an (la valeur de la capacité est celle correspondant à l'année en cours, la plus actuelle. Coverage: Haute-Garonne. The portal files it under Territoire. Its keywords are Énergie, Gaz, Biométhane, Environnement, Développement durable. The portal shows 5 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2022-07-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-haute-garonne-fr-portal.
